analysis.description: The paper investigates the use of machine learning methods to predict five-year all-cause mortality in COPD patients using electronic health records (EHR) data.

type.justification: The paper describes an empirical study as it involves the practical application of machine learning methods on real-world EHR data.
type.quote: A retrospective cohort study was conducted using EHR data on prescriptions and prescription renewals for COPD patients.
